prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: seamless square website background texture
Primary request: create a subtle, seamless, tileable optic-white performance football jersey jacquard knit mesh texture inspired by early-1990s German national football shirt material.
Scene/backdrop: a perfectly flat, edge-to-edge fabric swatch with no environment, no perspective, and no visible outer boundary.
Subject: premium lightweight synthetic jersey knit seen straight-on at macro scale, with a fine repeating ventilation mesh and understated woven jacquard structure.
Style/medium: photorealistic textile material scan, clean production-ready surface texture.
Composition/framing: orthographic straight-on square crop; uniform pattern density across the entire frame; opposing edges must join invisibly when tiled horizontally and vertically; no central focal point.
Lighting/mood: broad flat diffuse studio illumination with almost no directional shadow; calm, clean, premium.
Color palette: optic white and extremely pale cool gray only, approximately #f8f8f8 overall; very low contrast so black body copy remains fully legible.
Materials/textures: fine polyester micro-knit, tiny regular breathable mesh pores, subtle early-1990s technical jacquard weave, restrained tactile depth without visible folds.
Constraints: genuinely seamless/tileable; consistent scale and brightness at all four edges; no logo, no badge, no flag, no lettering, no numbers, no chevrons, no stripes, no person, no scene, no garment silhouette, no seams, no hems, no collar, no folds, no wrinkles, no stains, no watermark.
Avoid: black, red, gold, colored threads, heraldry, branding, recognizable symbols, strong moire, large perforations, harsh shadow, glossy plastic shine, dramatic lighting, vignetting, gradients, border effects.
